Build a permanent deterministic full-vehicle high-speed keyboard cornering regression/telemetry gate for Racing26. The current failure mode is: at road speed a held digital steering key can request huge rack angle, front slip exceeds useful range, tires saturate, and the car appears to go straight.

Create an integration test or diagnostic at representative 40/70/100/120 km/h that records digital request, actual center steering angle, front slip angles, tire lateral force or utilization where available, yaw rate, lateral acceleration, trajectory/turn radius, and wheel loads. Cover normal key hold/tap/release and exact mirrored left/right cases. The tests should define useful steering response and detect front saturation/over-command; they must NOT assert that normal high-speed keyboard input always reaches full mechanical lock. Separately leave room for emergency countersteer authority.

Do not tune tire grip just to make the test pass. Read AGENTS.md and PHYSICS_CONVENTIONS.md. Reuse existing deterministic physics harnesses. Run conventions, cornering, steering-direction, M5 transient/oversteer, strict validation, and build.
